definitions.gloss: lunch bag; bento bag; lunch pouch
definitions.explanation: A small bag or pouch designed to carry a bento box, typically insulated or made of cloth.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どもの{弁当袋|べんとうぶくろ}を{手作|てづく}りした。
examples.english: I handmade a lunch bag for my child.

examples.japanese: {保冷|ほれい}タイプの{弁当袋|べんとうぶくろ}は{夏場|なつば}に{便利|べんり}だ。
examples.english: An insulated lunch bag is handy in summer.

examples.japanese: {入学|にゅうがく}{準備|じゅんび}で、{弁当箱|べんとうばこ}と{弁当袋|べんとうぶくろ}と{水筒|すいとう}を{買|か}い{揃|そろ}えた。
examples.english: In preparation for school enrollment, I bought a bento box, lunch bag, and water bottle.

notes:
A compound of {弁当|べんとう} (boxed lunch, bento) and {袋|ぶくろ} (bag). In Japan, carrying a homemade bento to school or work is common, and a dedicated {弁当袋|べんとうぶくろ} is a standard item.

For children starting school, parents often make or buy matching sets of {弁当袋|べんとうぶくろ}, {弁当箱|べんとうばこ} (lunch box), and {箸|はし}ケース (chopstick case). Handmade lunch bags ({手作|てづく}り) are a tradition at many Japanese elementary schools.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {弁当袋|べんとうぶくろ}を{作|つく}る: to make a lunch bag
- {保冷|ほれい}{弁当袋|べんとうぶくろ}: insulated lunch bag
- {巾着|きんちゃく}{型|がた}の{弁当袋|べんとうぶくろ}: drawstring-style lunch bag
- {弁当袋|べんとうぶくろ}に{入|い}れる: to put in a lunch bag

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {弁当箱|べんとうばこ}: bento box, lunch box — the container for the food itself
- ランチバッグ: lunch bag — a more modern/Western-style term
- {風呂敷|ふろしき}: wrapping cloth — traditionally used to wrap and carry bento
